movement_profile.footwork: Quick and small steps on half feet.

signature_moves.description: Quick, small steps performed on the balls of the feet.
signature_moves.name: Half-feet steps

signature_moves.description: Frequent vertical movements integrated into the dance.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is driven by the gajda, a traditional bagpipe, set to a 2/4 rhythm.

basic_steps: Hold hands in a half-circle formation.
Execute quick, small steps on the half-feet.
Incorporate frequent jumps into the step sequence.
